propositions: Free-text schema extraction is fragile: trailing schema-valid decoys can win over correct payloads, and markdown fences are not a reliable channel because models fence-wrap quoted material.
Extend schema_directive to wrap the JSON object between literal line-anchored markers <<<REBAR_OUTPUT>>> and <<<END>>>, making payload location a stated contract instead of an inference.

Refactor parse_structured to factor current logic into _select_and_validate helper, then scan for complete marker blocks in document order, iterate blocks in reverse (last-first), and return the first block that validates; if no block validates or no markers present, fall back to full-reply selection unchanged.

Marker pairing follows a deterministic left-to-right, non-nested rule: each <<<REBAR_OUTPUT>>> pairs with the next <<<END>>>, markers are recognized only line-anchored (alone on their own line), and incomplete/unmatched markers are treated as absent.
Update the bounded-retry prompt in structured_run.py to name the same markers instead of instructing bare JSON, ensuring the fail-closed retry channel matches the first attempt.
Single-source the directive constant, markers, and retry instruction so extraction behavior, model instruction, and test assumptions never drift.
